title: Ecru names Jerry Horton grand marshal of Dec. 5 Christmas parade

paragraphs.text: Jerry Horton will serve as grand marshal of the 2026 Ecru Christmas Parade, the town announced Tuesday. He is scheduled to lead the parade through downtown Ecru on Saturday, December 5.

The town’s announcement highlighted Horton’s public service as an Ecru alderman and vice mayor, a member of the Mississippi House of Representatives for two terms, and Pontotoc County superintendent of education for three terms.
The announcement also noted the Horton Trophy, named in his honor and awarded to the winner of an annual football game between Pontotoc County schools.
